links.comparator_used: GPT-4 answering directly without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Overall satisfaction (primary), accuracy and empathy of responses to breast cancer nursing care questions
links.effect: Overall satisfaction 8.4 ± 0.84 vs. 5.4 ± 1.27 (p < 0.01); accuracy 8.6 ± 0.69 vs. 5.6 ± 0.96 (p < 0.01); empathy 8.4 ± 0.85 vs. 7.8 ± 1.22 (p > 0.05, no inter-group difference)
links.quote: The RAG-GPT group showed significantly higher overall satisfaction than that of the GPT-4 group (8.4 ± 0.84 vs. 5.4 ± 1.27, p < 0.01) as well as an improved accuracy of responses (8.6 ± 0.69 vs. 5.6 ± 0.96, p < 0.01).
